levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two real items under one or more headings, or items appear invented rather than genuine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two genuine items under each of the four headings.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and items span a genuinely varied range of the learner's actual life rather than repeating one activity across headings.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The strongest-item sentence stays vague, with no concrete detail or result.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The strongest-item sentence names a specific action and a specific detail or result.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the sentence would be understandable to a stranger with no other context.

lookFors: No last name, address, or phone number appears anywhere on the document.
The reflection names one genuinely forgotten item, not a restatement of an item already listed.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
